name: Creating Additional Relics
summary: When the GM creates another relic, start with an existing weapon, armour or item rather than inventing a new numerical scale. Add one memorable capability, one limited high-impact ability, or one rule-changing interaction. If an item simply grants a permanent +1 attack, +1 AC or a reroll, use the Master-Crafted rules instead. Relics should create choices, tactics or story consequences rather than mandatory arithmetic upgrades.
